title: Choosing an algorithmic fairness metric for an online marketplace: Detecting and quantifying algorithmic bias on LinkedIn
reasoning: The paper's central purpose is to derive a quantitative metric from a specific ethical principle, the 'fairness notion of equal opportunity for equally qualified candidates.' It engages in a deep analysis of how to operationalize this ethical concept in a real-world system and critiques other common fairness metrics based on their alignment with this notion. This work is fundamentally about the application and measurement of ethics in AI, going far beyond a cursory 'ethical considerations' section.
